reason: The text fragment is a narrative account from Exodus 2:16-22 describing Moses' encounter at the well in Midian with the daughters of the priest of Midian. While the Hebrew word 'כֹהֵן' (priest) appears once to describe the father of these daughters, the passage makes no mention of sacrifice, offerings, or any regulations about who may offer sacrifices to Yahweh. The text deals entirely with a domestic narrative—drawing water for flocks, shepherds, and Moses meeting his future wife—and contains no theological content regarding sacrificial practices or priestly authority over sacrifice.
